items.title: Show HN: Celorga – A portable re-implementation of Org for you and your agents
items.contentSnippet:
I've been a heavy user of Emacs Org mode for a decade and a half. As AI has reduced how often I'm using a text-editor, I was finding myself tied to spacemacs just for Org, and I was searching for a way to keep those workflows and notes, but be fully decoupled from Emacs. (I blogged about that here: https://avi.press/posts/2024-01-15-standalone-org.html, the original idea for this project).

items.title: Show HN: Reversing Wing Commander to find the entity table in 64k to add co-op
items.contentSnippet:
I've always wanted to play Wing Commander with friends, so we could
fly the story missions together. In 2015, I hypothesized that the full
game state fit in the data segment (only 64k), and I could do small
position and orientation experiments with vbindiff to discover how the
memory was organized. Some fun findings: the camera was in entity index

items.contentSnippet: This op-ed from Georgetown, Texas mother Courtney Parker Lopez offers what the school choice debate almost never surfaces: a ground-level, human account of why one family left public school, how they navigated Texas's new education savings account program, and what it cost them emotionally before it ever cost the state a dollar. items.title: AI researchers stranded Claude on a virtual desert island. It started to “play.”
